notes.title: Scroll of Beasts
notes.content:
[p][i]As the world teeters on the edge of oblivion, it’s not fire or famine that greets you first on the path—it’s the faces. Twisted. Masked. Forgotten. Sancticide’s world may be stalled in the End Times, but its horrors are anything but static.
[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png"][/img][/p][p]
With each major patch on the road to 1.0, [b]we’ve reshaped what stands between you and final judgment[/b]. Some enemies have been reforged, others emerged from the darkness for the first time. Each has a story. A purpose. A design, often divine, always broken.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/212df16e03567ec7eb6b8525a1dd85298a3f6157.png"][/img]
[/p][p]🔔 [b]Ringer[/b]  - Once a common foe, now rebuilt to resist the old tactic of spamming strikes and powers. 
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/7670ba264c36a605042d205a053aa87947b38aa4.png"][/img]
[/p][p] 🪓 [b]Viscerator[/b] - A walking error of judgment. Four men fused into one abomination, wrapped in crude armor and armed with whatever sharp, heavy metal was lying around. The math didn’t add up, but the blood certainly does.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/f292602f8dedcd9580e0e2ebe22b94036d8905f8.png"][/img] [/p][p]
📿 [b]Reliquary[/b] - Cloaked in relics and fragments of sacred iconography, this Purple user channels the will of forgotten angels, but bows to no one, not even the Sin Collector.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/fe82f2e1944689b3a0df1dc12737f8362c86a424.png"][/img]
[/p][p] 👁️‍🗨️ [b]Dybbuk[/b] - Possession incarnate. When the host is broken, the demonic cloud leaves only to seek a new one. Kill fast, or risk becoming its next shell.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png"][/img][/p][p]
And these are just the visible scars on the body of the world. Behind the curtain, more beasts boil in the mire. [b]Each update brings new creatures, new challenges, [/b]and new reworks driven by [b]your feedback, reports, and even your frustrations[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We're not done yet.[/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ [b]More enemies are coming.[/b] Some will crawl out of the Reversed side of reality. Some will descend from what’s left of the Heavens. And some-well, some were always here, just waiting.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for walking this road with us. The apocalypse is far from over, but every step, patch, and encounter gets us closer to the world we want Sancticide to be.[/p][p]💀 [i]Sharpen your blade.
[/i]👁️ [i]Stay watchful.
[/i]📜 [i]Please check back soon, as the judgment is still in progress.

- Red Square Games Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 📜 Patch 0.93 is Live!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Sin Collectors,[/p][p]Patch [b]0.93[/b] is now live – and while it may not be the biggest content drop, it brings a number of important additions and improvements based on your continued feedback and support.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🇭🇺 Hungarian Language Support[/b][/h3][p]We’re thrilled to welcome our Hungarian players, with [b]full language support[/b] now available in-game! Thank you for your patience. We hope this makes your descent into the apocalypse all the more immersive.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]
🗺️ New Expedition Side Quest[/b][/h3][p]A [b]brand-new expedition[/b] is now available for the most daring collectors. This optional side quest introduces a [b]small-scale boss encounter[/b] – a test of your skills and a chance to uncover new secrets lurking in the shadows of the End Times. Will you find glory or meet your final judgment?[/p][h3][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]🔧 Quality of Life & Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]We've also implemented a range of fixes and minor improvements reported by you, our community. [/p][p]As always, we’re closely listening to your reports and suggestions. Thank you for helping us shape Sancticide into something stronger with each patch.[/p][p]
[/p][p]⚔️ Keep fighting the good fight and sharing your feedback and bug reports!
[/p][p]Stay righteous (or not),
— The Red Square Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Beyond the Storm Front: Sancticide Patch 0.92 Now Live!
notes.content:
The world of Sancticide expands with [b]Patch 0.92[/b], bringing new challenges, deadly environments, and monstrous adversaries for you to face.

[h2]🌆[b] Main Highlights[/b]:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/617ac59b6cf8a065b375e71cce2aee4513d18886.png[/img]

[h3]🏙 [b]New level: City of Heroes[/b][/h3] — Explore a frozen, grim world of eternal darkness, where occultism, Orthodox faith, and technology intertwine to protect the remnants of humanity from the creatures of their nightmares.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/637412f5eb01fcccb91eb392b05cfd35fbe41bce.png[/img]

[h3]⛈ [b]New location: Storm Front[/b][/h3] — A colossal ~30-kilometer-wide belt circling the Earth, forming a natural boundary between Avers and Revers. Wracked by relentless storms and starved of light, it’s one of the most desolate and treacherous regions. Expect endless mud, wreckage, floods, savage winds, and lost Envoys or creatures of the Revers lurking in the chaos.


[h3]💀 [b]New enemies:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/50c72b42347f43ef72b0cb90d4f5f6caf9d3e22c.png[/img]

[b]Viscerator[/b] – Four bodies, one bad idea. The Viscerator is a monstrous fusion golem, clad in crude armor and armed with whatever it can grab—swords, axes, or even car parts. Immune to pain and fear, it’s a brute force nightmare that advances relentlessly, chopping everything in its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/d41eb90ea40927251b2476614760bb7637843a17.png[/img]

[b]Dybbuk[/b] – The embodiment of demonic possession. When a dybbuk seizes a host, the victim becomes a puppet of spasms, shrieks, and aggression. Kill its host, and it morphs into a black, swirling cloud—drifting fast, ready to corrupt the next unlucky soul.

[h3]🗡[b] New weapons[/b][/h3] — Discover fresh tools of destruction to cleanse the world of its sins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png[/img]

[b]🎮 Plus:[/b]


[list]
[*] Combat tweaks & visual polish

[*] Quality of life changes

[*] Community-driven bug fixes and performance updates
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png[/img]

⚠ Important: Please note that [u][b]previous save files may not be compatible[/b][/u] with this patch.
Your feedback continues to shape Sancticide. 

[h3]Dive into the new content, and if you’re enjoying your experience, please consider leaving us a positive Steam review—every review goes a long way in helping our small team grow.
[/h3]

Thanks for crossing the Storm Front with us,

 — The Red Square Games Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Roadmap Update – Patch 0.92 Postponement 🛠️
notes.content:
Sin Collectors,

We wanted to let you know that the upcoming [b]major patch, 0.92[/b], featuring a brand-new level, enemies, and weapons, will be slightly delayed and is [u][b]now scheduled for early May[/b][/u].

With the spring holidays and break approaching, we want to ensure that once the patch is live, we're fully available to respond to your feedback, address any potential issues, and be present for the community during launch.

We truly appreciate your patience and support. We need to release this update when we can give it and [u]you[/u] the attention it deserves.

Stay tuned! 💀⚔️

— The Sancticide Team

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS: PATCH 0.91 IS LIVE
notes.content:
The first [b]major update for Sancticide[/b] has arrived, bringing new content, enemy encounters, and key improvements based on your feedback. This is just the beginning of our Early Access Roadmap, and we’re committed to shaping the game with your input!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png[/img]


[h1][b]New Content & Features
[/b][/h1]

⚔️ [b]New Level: The City[/b]
 Once a thriving metropolis, now a burning ruin and a battleground between the forces of Them at The Top and all manner of sinners. Survivors hide in the metro tunnels, resisting their inevitable fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/d22dc4335d3b1cf04fe1177a92874368678af7cd.png[/img]

🦴 [b]New Enemy: Reliquary[/b]
A master of relics, the Reliquary understands the workings of angels and wields their sacred artifacts against the forces of Them at The Top. Covered from head to toe in shimmering trinkets, this Purple user bows to no one—not angels, not demons, and certainly not the Sin Collector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/8819f6c31445958e270bad962eaace3fccc3012e.png[/img]

🏛️ [b]New Location: The Colosseum[/b]
 A place of trials and combat, where Sin Collectors face ruthless challenges in the name of justice.

🗡️ [b]5 New Weapons to Master[/b]

Mindelheim Sword

Khopesh

Falcata

Studded Club

Baseball Bat


[b]Fixes & Improvements[/b]

🚨 [b]IMPORTANT NOTICE:[/b] Due to significant game structure changes, previous save files will not work with this update. We understand this may be frustrating, but these adjustments were necessary to improve the overall experience.

✅ [b]Camera Overhaul[/b] – We've significantly adjusted the camera system, particularly for players using a controller. Movement, tracking, and responsiveness have been fine-tuned to improve your overall experience. We know how important a smooth camera is, and we're continuously working on making it even better—expect further refinements in future updates.

✅ [b]Key level design improvements[/b] ensure smoother exploration.

✅ [b]Combat Balance Tweaks[/b] – Adjustments to combat mechanics for better combat flow.

✅ Various Minor Fixes & Improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png[/img]

This is the first step in our Early Access Roadmap. We'll have more updates, and we’re actively working on your feedback—so keep sharing your thoughts!

[h1]Jump in, test the changes, and tell us what you think!
[/h1]

notes.title: The Path Ahead: Sancticide Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Sin Collectors,

You've recently stepped into the apocalyptic world of Sancticide in Early Access, and today, we're sharing a glimpse of the road ahead.

Our [b]Early Access Roadmap[/b] outlines the key additions and improvements we plan to make. These aim to deepen the game's story, expand your experience, and refine Ezechiel the Seventh's brutal journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/aa0052feef6ea84efe298a3a35db80f90195970a.png[/img]

[h2][b]⚔️ March 2025 — First Major Update:[/b][/h2]

⚫ [b]New Level: City [/b]— Once a thriving metropolis, now a burning ruin and a battleground between the forces of Them at The Top and all sinners. The few survivors of the Biblical Apocalypse hide in the metro tunnels, resisting until their inevitable demise at the hands of the Sin Collector.

⚫ [b]New Location: Colosseum[/b] — The Colosseum is a new location that players may encounter while carrying out their duties as a Sin Collector.

⚫ [b]5 New Weapons:[/b] Mindelheim Sword, Khopesh, Falcata, Studded Club, and Baseball Bat.

⚫ [b]New Enemy: Reliquary[/b] — A master of relics, Reliquary understands the workings of angels and wields their sacred artifacts against the forces of Them at The Top. Covered from head to toe in shimmering trinkets, this Purple user bows to no one—not angels, not demons, and certainly not the Sin Collector.

This roadmap marks the foundation of what's to come, but it's not set in stone. [b]Your feedback will continue to shape Sancticide[/b], and we’re committed to adapting the game based on your insights and experiences.

Prepare yourselves. The End Times evolve — and so will your path through them.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Try Santicide Demo
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Sin Collectors…[/h3]

The End Times await you. The demo for Sancticide is now available on Steam. Embark on a dark journey through an apocalyptic world and become a Sin Collector!

Sancticide is a melee-focused TPP action game with rogue-lite elements, set in a world of the biblical Apocalypse. The combat system based on spatial and directional awareness pays homage to the games of yore while manipulating the environment and physically interacting with it expands tactical possibilities.

The unique, twisted setting serves as a backdrop to the tale of Ezechiel - a fresh recruit to the Sin Collector Corps, haunted by remorse and guilt as he embarks on one of his most important missions yet. Explore the unforgiving world in which death is not the end, but merely another beginning.

KEY FEATURES:

[list]
[*] Unique Combat System: A hybrid of arena fighters and TPP action, featuring direction-based attacks, organic combos, and a diverse array of melee/ranged weapons and powers.
[*] Sin Collector Powers: Harness "Purple" powers to manipulate space, time, and objects, with both passive and active abilities to influence combat.
[*] Enemy Differentiation: Each enemy has distinct traits, helping players quickly gauge strengths, weaknesses, and movement styles.
[*] Death as Progress: Death isn’t just punishment—it’s a learning experience, allowing players to adapt and evolve in a persistent world.
[*] Kosherness: Items and beings are classified as Kosher or unKosher, affecting sidequests, relationships, equipment, and access to certain areas.
[*] Story & Sidequests: Follow Ezechiel's trials during the apocalypse, exploring themes of suffering, hope, and the daily life of a Sin Collector.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=vGNgy91oRnU;full][/previewyoutube]

We welcome your feedback, opinions, and suggestions. If you stumble upon any bugs in the Sancticide demo, please report them using the Community Hub forum. 

[h3]⚔️ Play Demo now and add Sancticide to your Wishlist on Steam![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2635050/Sancticide/
